chunks: The revelation of the Book is from God, the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
ai.seo_question: Who revealed the Quran according to Islamic theology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute authority (Al-Aziz) and omniscience (Al-Alim) of God as the guarantor of the Quran's integrity and truth. It establishes the scripture not merely as text, but as a divine revelation rooted in God's perfect attributes, reinforcing the concept of Ismah (infallibility) in the preservation of the Word. This attribution serves as a theological anchor for believers, affirming that the Quran's guidance is beyond human error or alteration.
